history.description: seed baseline rl.py unmodified
knapsack per-target k allocation: round budget window x 32 split by difficulty weight, length prior L6 1 to L11 8 for unseen targets, solve rate weights 1/4/8 for seen, k clipped 4-128
length-weighted stratified target subset: quota weights L6 0.5 L7 1 L8 1.5 L9 2 L10 2 L11 3 of 6000 targets (300/600/900/1200/1200/1800)
best-of-n by length: max_per_thm 4 proofs per solved target selected shortest-first by pruned then written length instead of random shuffle

schema sibling spreading: first solve of a textbook schema instance pulls up to 32 unsolved same-schema siblings from the whole 15.7k pool to the queue front, nearest length first, at most 160 per round
history.source: own idea (run-1 finding on schema ignition)

history.description: prefix branching restarts: unsolved window targets resample 8 continuations from each of up to 4 longest verifier-valid line prefixes of failed samples, cap 0.4 x window x k per round
token-level multi-temperature sampling: line-head tokens (box-depth bars plus first 2 formula tokens of each proof line) at decision_temp 1.4, other tokens at 1.0, training samples only
exploratory annealed decoding for training samples: per-token temperature max(2.2 - exp(t/600), 0.7), 1.2 at token 0 cooling to 0.7 by token 245
crossover: length-weighted stratified target subset quotas L6 0.5 L7 1 L8 1.5 L9 2 L10 2 L11 3 transplanted from n002 onto shortest-first proof selection n003
shape-weighted cap6 retention: half of the 20000 retained cap6 records drawn from proofs using NEGI ORE BOTE DN reductio case-split rules

line-verified sampling: incremental fitch line checker on each generated proof line, rejected lines masked from kv cache and resampled from stored line-start logits, 4 retries per line, 16 per proof, then row killed
near-miss refill: unsolved targets in hardest-first refills ordered by best verifier-valid prefix fraction of failed samples (learnability proxy) instead of random
negative sample reinforcement nsr: minimise 0.25 x log-prob of the first verifier-invalid line (whole line incl. index and depth tokens) of failed samples, 32 negatives per sft step
wise-ft weight ensembling at end of run: early snapshot at 40 percent budget, alpha 1.0 0.7 0.5 chosen by pass@16 on 300 unused L9-11 pool targets, 45 s reserved; alpha 1.0 was chosen
crossover: shortest-first pruned-length proof selection transplanted from n003 onto prefix branching n005
crossover: knapsack per-target k allocation from n001 (length prior L6 1 to L11 8, solve rate weights 1/4/8) transplanted onto shortest-first proof selection n003
line-verified main-pass sampling (incremental fitch line checker, bad lines masked from kv cache and resampled, 4 retries per line, 16 per proof) added to prefix branching restarts
gem loss replaces token cross entropy in every fine-tune step, beta 0.7, logsigmoid weights, q softmax(z/beta) detached, rl and cap6 records alike
crossover: shortest-first max_per_thm proof selection by pruned then written length transplanted from n003 onto line-head decision temperature n006
difficulty-balanced refill: half of each 1200-target hardest-first refill replaced by fresh never-sampled pool targets outside the 6000 subset, equal quota per true length
